title: No automated process maintains signal index and catalogue lifecycle: archiving, status transitions, and dedup are entirely manual
description:
The signals/index.md and catalogue/ are maintained manually with no automation. This produces several failure modes observed in the signal backlog: (1) status fields diverge from actual run state (a1000031); (2) duplicate signals accumulate because dedup uses file-path as identity key instead of root-cause title+category (6bfc810c); (3) stale references to eliminated files persist in skill reasoning (a7f3e2b1, b8f4e3c2); (4) resolved/superseded signals remain in the active index indefinitely, growing it to 200+ rows. A process signal (and associated MCP tooling) is needed to drive lifecycle transitions atomically.

The agreed archive structure is:
  signals/index.md           — active signals only
  signals/catalogue/         — active .signal.json files
  signals/archive/index.md   — archived signals
  signals/archive/catalogue/ — archived .signal.json files

Signal JSON schema additions needed:
  resolution_summary: string | null   — one-sentence description of the fix that worked
  superseded_by: UUID | null          — points to the consolidating signal
  archived_on: ISO8601 | null         — set when moved to archive
proposed_resolution:
1. Add resolution_summary, superseded_by, and archived_on fields to the signal JSON schema and spec-schema-validation.json.
2. Implement a lifecycle-transition MCP tool (or extend fix_signal) that atomically: updates status, sets archived_on, moves the file to archive/catalogue/, and moves the index row to archive/index.md.
3. Update the dedup identity key to use normalised(title + category) instead of file path (fixes 6bfc810c).
4. Add a post-run hook to run.skill.md and fix_signal.skill.md that calls the lifecycle tool on any signal whose status changed during the run.
5. Add an archive integrity check: run signal counts in index.md must equal count of files in catalogue/ at all times.
